editorial_thesis: W41 is a measured-rollout versus vendor-claim week with provenance as the verifiable through-line. OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Intelligent UI tiers and a changelog-pinned Decisions API beta while Anthropic answered with Haiku 5.5 pricing and a Cyber Mission program; Google shipped a Nano Banana image-model card and a SynthID portal scope expansion while OpenAI shipped measured EU text-watermark results. Downloadable open weights (Kolibri, Liquid d1, EmbeddingGemma 2) contrast honestly with promised weights (Beam, Mistral Large 4), and decision-model forum announcements stay briefs rather than benchmark leadership. Every vendor number stays publisher-measured; every gated, unread or clock-less source stays an explicit boundary.
architecture_goals: Present GPT-6 and Haiku as a priced, tiered frontier pair with the 44% figure kept strictly as vendor time-to-start and all benchmarks vendor-attributed.
Contrast the verified Decisions changelog against forum-observed Perplexity models, a verified Ultrafast infra tier and a stub-only Gemini announcement without inventing API or rollout detail.
Separate shipped weights from promised weights and preview APIs in one availability table with license, location and download-status columns; keep the Mistral version pin unresolved.
Present the Nano Banana card as a bounded spec brief with admissible narrowed blog-search language and the legacy phrase confined to the machine trace.
Pair first-hand textGrain watermark numbers against SynthID portal scope with PDF-unread and no-efficacy boundaries and no cross-modality equivalence.
Collect Cyber Mission, mathematics results and Ironclad simulation as bounded briefs with no deployment, leadership or product-launch inference.

page_plan.notes: No page-count cap is imposed at Architecture. Relative weight proposal: P1 large (frontier lead); P2 medium-large (agent platform with changelog anchor); P3 large (weights availability table plus speech comparator); P4 small brief (image spec box); P5 medium-large (provenance pair with figures table); P6 small digest (three bounded briefs). Package order is editorial and drafting order. Comparison tables are required in P1 (tier/price/latency-definition), P3 (license/location/availability/date) and P5 (modality/gating/verification status). Figure and table sourcing is first-party pages and bounded excerpts only. Page allocation is a downstream drafting concern; no rendered PDF pagination is fixed at this stage.
